name: Suno
summary: AI music generator with a free daily credit plan and paid tiers.
description: Suno generates original music from text. suno.ai redirected to suno.com. The pricing page on 21 October 2026 listed Free at $0 with 50 credits a day, Pro at $8/month when billed yearly, and Premier at $24/month when billed yearly. The previous Free-only label missed the paid plans.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Free $0 (50 credits/day). Pro $8/month and Premier $24/month on the yearly prices shown.

features: AI Music Generation: Creates songs based on user inputs.
Genre Versatility: Supports various musical genres.
Lyric Integration: Generates lyrics to accompany compositions.
Rapid Composition: Produces complete songs in seconds.

howToUse.title: Visit Suno Website
howToUse.description: Access Suno via their platform to start generating music.

howToUse.title: Describe or Select Style
howToUse.description: Enter a text prompt or select genre and style for your composition.

howToUse.title: Generate Song
howToUse.description: Let the AI create music and lyrics based on your input.

howToUse.title: Download or Share
howToUse.description: Export the composition or share it directly.
